EPG.role: Heading bump around the ellipsoid body

PEG.role: Feeds the bump back to itself

Delta7.role: Long-range inhibition that keeps one bump

PFL.role: Compares goal against heading and drives descending neurons

ER.role: Ring neurons carrying sensory cues to the compass

scope: Traced central-complex navigation types plus the lab's descending targets, with the measured edges among them. Functional group labels are assignments by type prefix from published roles, not measurements. Column identity is parsed from instance strings and may be incomplete; check with --probe.
